)
SELECT
    year,
    total_amount,
    LAG(total_amount) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS prev_year_amount,
    (total_amount - LAG(total_amount) OVER (ORDER BY year)) / NULLIF(LAG(total_amount) OVER (ORDER BY year), 0) * 100 AS pct_growth
FROM yearly_totals
ORDER BY year;
